snippet.textDisplay:
Our tamil movie industry is just going wild... you guys are throwing in drugs, drinks, and all that stuff.. even in the trailers 😶 

It’s like, come on, as young people, we’re really influenced by this, right? 

i just graduated two years ago, and yeah, we had our fun in college, but it wasn’t all about partying and fighting with different departments every day. that’s just not how it is...

these days, I see a lot of college students feeling down because of all the negativity around them... like not getting jobs and seeing their seniors struggle too. But honestly, I haven’t seen a movie in the last few years that really makes an impact. 

It's all about alcohol, drugs, and superficial stuff, and it’s pretty disappointing. 

If someone in the industry could come up with a script that actually makes people think, that would be amazing! Sure, it might not be the typical blockbuster, but it would definitely be good for the industry. 

I really hope someone hears this because it would make me happy to see some positive change 😊
